title: RDW–MCV coupling does not improve cross-cycle prediction of elevated CRP beyond flexible routine measures
abstract: Adding RDW × MCV/100 to a fixed flexible routine-measure model did not improve CRP >3 mg/L prediction when transferred from NHANES 2007–08 (n=5239) to independently sampled 2003–04 adults (n=4395): weighted Brier improvement -0.0000248, joint survey-PSU bootstrap 95% interval [-0.0004541, 0.0003259].
